title: L-bracket
sentence: Two boxes unioned into an L-shaped bracket, wall-mounted and end-loaded — `geometry.add`'s union in one model.

expected.reference: no closed form; the peak sits at the re-entrant corner

theory: The peak stress is at the re-entrant corner, where the exact elastic solution is singular: refine the mesh and the number keeps rising. Report a stress away from the corner, or a fillet radius, never the corner value itself.
